$comment: Single-sourced from concordance scope §7 + plan.md §7 risk note (schema drift between producer and consumer). GET /version response. Returns the runtime version-negotiation surface so external consumers (OODS Foundry, divergent-inspector at scale, future MCP-adapter clients) can pin a contract version they integrate against. Authored s12-m02.
title: VersionResponse

service_version.description: Concordance Python package version per pyproject.toml [project].version. Bumps on releases (no semver enforced at v0; the wire-contract semver is schema_version).

schema_version.description: Wire-contract version (semver). Read from contracts/manifest.schema.json's top-level 'version' field. Same value is emitted as the Concordance-Schema-Version response header on every endpoint. Semver semantics: minor bump = additive non-breaking; major bump = breaking + cross-project coordination per plan.md §4.

recipe_versions.description: Per-recipe semver. Keys: semantic_location, debug_or_explain, modify_ui_copy, action_eligibility. Values read from contracts/recipes/<recipe>.json's 'version' field. Recipes can evolve independently of the manifest schema; future bumps may differ across recipes.

current_sprint_id.description: Internal sprint identifier from src/concordance/eval/baselines.py CURRENT_SPRINT_ID. Useful for correlating runtime behavior with the SPRINT_BASELINES gate the harness enforces, and for build-vs-snapshot reasoning across the divergence pipeline.

build_hash.description: git rev-parse HEAD when concordance is launched from a git checkout; null in non-git environments (e.g., installed wheel). Useful for cross-project reproducibility receipts.
